{{Quote|Well, I can only confirm this in the case of the successful opera singer Ubbla Mollbro, who is currently looking for a potential partner in the casino city of Canto Bight…|"Species From A to Z"|<ref name="Species From A to Z">{{TOMCite|115|Database}}</ref>}}
'''Ubbla Mollbro''' was a boisterous [[Gender|female]] [[Xi'Dec]] [[opera]] [[Musician|singer]] spent time in the [[city]] [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]]. Her presence was due to her search for a hatching partner. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]], while mingling with Canto Bight's elite at the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]], her activities were interrupted by a stampede of [[fathier]]s; the creatures were released by a [[Finn|pair]] [[Rose Tico|of]] [[Resistance]] members during their attempt to escape from the city [[Law enforcement agency|police]]. Confronted by the sight of the Resistance members riding a fathier directly towards her, Mollbro simple raised her arms high and screamed with a harmonic note.

==Biography==
Ubbla Mollbro was a [[Gender|female]] [[Xi'Dec]] [[opera]] [[Musician|singer]] who managed to accumulate a sizable amount of riches for herself<ref name="TLJVD" /> by the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] carries on immediately from the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it can be assumed to take place in the same [[Standard year|year]].</ref> Her wealth was not without punishment, however; the ultra rich disdainfully labeled the opera singer as "new [[Currency|money]],"<ref name="TLJVD" /> in contrast to their long held riches.<ref name="Mollbro-DB">{{Databank|ubbla-mollbro|Ubbla Mollbro}}</ref> However, this did little to dampen Mollbro's spirits.<ref name="TLJVD" />

At some point, [[egg sac]]s covering her body grew to an engorged size,<ref name="TLJVD" /> and in the [[New Republic Era]]<ref name="Species From A to Z" /> she made her way to the [[Canto Bight]] [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|casino]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]] in search of a hatching partner.<ref name="TLJVD" /> During her time on Cantonica, Mollbro was mentioned as a notable Xi'Dec in "[[Species From A to Z]]," a survival compendium sent out by [[Carson Teva]].<ref name="Species From A to Z" />

In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> while brushing up against the [[casino]]'s<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> unapproving<ref name="Mollbro-DB" /> elite, Mollbro's activities came to a halt when the casino floor was flooded with casino's contingent of race [[fathier]]s. The [[horse]]-like creatures had been ushered into a stampede by two members of the [[Resistance]], [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]], who were [[Mission to Canto Bight|escaping]] from [[Canto Bight Police Department|police custody]]. As Finn and Tico's fathier sped in her direction, Mollbro raised her four arms and screamed out in a smooth, harmonic note. The sight managed to distract Finn's attention away from the chaos he had brewed in the casino. Ultimately, Mollbro avoided being crushed by the fathier.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Personality and traits==
A pale, off-[[Color|white]] skinned member of the Xi'Dec [[species]], Ubbla Mollbro was a boisterous opera singer<ref name="Mollbro-DB" /> whose aptitude for making grand entrances<ref name="TLJVD" /> muted the scornful [[eye]]s of the "old-money" that contemptuously stared her down.<ref name="Mollbro-DB" /> Covered in engorged, yet well-maintained [[egg]] sacs, Mollbro was eager to find a hatching partner among Canto Bight's elite.<ref name="TLJVD" />

The mint-eyed singer's inimitable style sense<ref name="Mollbro-DB" /> led to her casino attire comprising of a self-spun web-chiffon drape and her gray-colored [[hair]] to be formed into a layered pyramid atop her head.<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ubbla Mollbro first appeared, albeit unnamed, in the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> and was identified by name in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> Mollbro was designed by creature concept artist [[Tim Napper]].<ref name="Napper">{{ArtStation|username=artofnapper|url=projects/YaomaV|name=Tim Napper|text=Canto Bight|archivedate=20200531210322}}</ref>
